_doc: Render massing for the Sint-Elooiskerk, read by pipeline/src/scene.ts. Metres in Lambert 72 around 'anchor' (centre of GRB footprint 7376474), u along 'axis_deg' (west tower -> east choir), v to the north. From DHMV II: nave ridge 23 m along v ~ -5 (aisles ~10 m), a transept or chapels around u 15-21 to ~18 m, the west tower at u -18..-12, v 1..7 with its slate spire (LiDAR 50 m on a 1 m grid, 56 m per notes.md). Neo-Gothic red brick with a slate needle on an octagonal base, a round stair turret beside the tower (photos of the Overleiestraat, look-up only).
